With STRIX_HC_INJECT_FUSE=0 STRIX_GDN_R16=0 STRIX_SKINNY_F32=0 STRIX_MMB_F32_MIN_T=512 every token and top-5 probability is 0.1.17's
accuracy.why_not_bitwise: the inject's four per-stream partial sums, the GDN kernel's decay-scaled state (folded back below 2^-20) and the narrow F32 kernels add in another order than 0.1.17; this model amplifies a last-bit difference (a 1-ULP change moves single-chunk KLD by 0.01-0.024), so perplexity over 8 chunks and per-kernel difference checks are the measure, not one chunk's KLD

bug_found_by_the_release_checks: with a q8_0 cache perplexity was 9.75: the QSA pack fusion read its source (the cache dequantized to f16 in the compute buffer) after the allocator had given that memory to the fused output. graph_optimize now adds an allocation dependency (the source stays allocated until the output is computed), for the pack and the gate copy fusions, and the dispatch refuses overlapping memory. After the fix: 2.6927
release_checks: tmp/kvr/gates_020.sh -> gates_020b.out, all pass: equivalence probe (text identical; bitwise with the four switches off); q8_0 history independence (B over A's freed cells hashes as B alone after every batch); MTP rewind at 85K, 400 tokens identical twice (prefill 1172.9 t/s); 173K + 155K conversations read back from disk equal resident; vision stress with the disk tier; 137K shared-slot conversation, no assert; allocation failure at a checkpoint recovers to the same tokens; truncation 30/30 twice, 1216 tokens; 40-turn agent workload on four slots, no warning; four streams 49.8 tok/s; PPL as above
ple_unbuffered: a cold 2K-token gather of per-layer-embedding rows 240 -> 58 ms (16 requests in flight on each of 16 workers, FILE_FLAG_NO_BUFFERING; any buffered handle or mapping of the file drops such reads to ~8K IOPS). The RAM cache (STRIX_PLE_CACHE_MB, default 400) keeps the raw rows read
